help.tips[0].examples[0].en: Newer studies, however, suggest that the structure of a language influences perception.
help.tips[0].examples[1].en: For a long time it was assumed that language was merely a tool for expressing thoughts.
help.tips[0].check.whyEn: Lange Zeit ging man davon aus plus the Konjunktiv I sei reports an older assumption, usually followed by a jedoch turn.
help.tips[0].en.text: In der heutigen Sitzung beschäftigen wir uns mit der Frage, … (question) → Lange Zeit nahm man an, … (old view, Konjunktiv) → Neuere Studien legen jedoch nahe, dass … (turn, evidence) → Ich halte den Einfluss für … (assessment) → Im zweiten Teil werde ich … (outlook).
help.tips[0].en.title: The lecture's scaffolding
help.tips[1].examples[0].en: I consider this influence real, but much smaller than is often claimed.
help.tips[1].examples[1].en: So there is some evidence that language steers our attention but does not limit our thinking.
help.tips[1].check.whyEn: halten für gives the speaker's own verdict, and the hedge aber für klein limits it.
help.tips[1].en.text: Studien legen nahe (suggest), Forscher vermuten (suppose), ich halte den Einfluss für begrenzt (I consider … limited), es spricht einiges dafür (there is some evidence). When you ask yourself 'Wie bewertet der Redner …?', the answer is the hedge.
help.tips[1].en.title: Hedged claims: nahelegen, vermuten, halten für
help.tips[2].examples[0].en: The question is not whether but to what extent language shapes our thinking.
help.tips[2].examples[1].en: In today's session we deal with the question of to what extent our language influences our thinking.
help.tips[2].check.whyEn: inwiefern means to what extent, so the answer will be a matter of degree, not yes or no.
help.tips[2].en.text: The lecture's question is not ob (whether) but inwiefern (to what extent) — a signal that the answer will be graded, not yes/no. Expect 'teilweise', 'in gewissem Maße', 'begrenzt'.
help.tips[2].en.title: inwiefern = to what extent
help.hookEn: Follow a lecture's argument as it unfolds — the old view, the new evidence, the speaker's own verdict — after hearing it once.
help.introEn: A university lecture opening — heard once — on whether language shapes thought: the question (inwiefern …), the traditional assumption (lange nahm man an, Sprache sei lediglich ein Werkzeug — Konjunktiv I), the newer evidence (neuere Studien legen jedoch nahe, dass …) with three numbered examples, the speaker's own assessment (ich halte diesen Einfluss für real, aber …), and the plan for the second part. In a lecture or a talk the skill is following the argument's scaffolding — Frage, Annahme, Gegenposition, Bewertung, Ausblick — and hearing the verbs that mark each: annehmen, nahelegen (suggest), vermuten, belegen, bewerten, ankündigen. The Konjunktiv I marks the view being reported (sei lediglich ein Werkzeug); the indicative marks what the speaker holds; jedoch marks the turn.
help.rememberEn[1]: nahelegen, vermuten, halten für: the speaker's degree of certainty is a question.
help.examEn: Lecture excerpts with detail questions are a standard listening text in the C1 exam — and at any German university.
